time_plan.30m: Check whether any OpenAI-related headline or credible leak has hit newswires; compare MSFT pre/post move against SPX to isolate idiosyncratic move.
time_plan.1h: Re-check Polymarket implied probability persistence and MSFT options implied vol / call skew for confirmation.

predictions.reasoning: OpenAI is private, so the most liquid public proxy for OpenAI capability breakthroughs is Microsoft, which holds a large equity stake and exclusive commercialization rights. A sharp rise in the implied probability of an AGI announcement could reflect leaked capability progress; a genuine confirmed AGI announcement would be a large positive re-rating catalyst for MSFT. However, MSFT is a $3T diversified megacap, so even a dramatic OpenAI story translates into a modest single-stock move, and the AGI 'announcement' framing is highly ambiguous and self-declared by OpenAI, weakening the linkage.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Scan for AI-sector news and check NVDA relative to SOX index for idiosyncratic vs sector move.
time_plan.1h: Check whether options flow / gamma is amplifying an unfounded spike.
time_plan.2h: Confirm breadth across AI names; isolated NVDA move without narrative is likely noise.
time_plan.6h: Look for any official OpenAI communication; reassess if probability spike fades.
time_plan.12h: Record whether AI complex sustained gains; note that absence of official announcement likely caps upside.

predictions.reasoning: A credible signal of accelerating frontier-model capability would reinforce the compute-demand narrative that drives NVDA and the broader AI trade. NVDA benefits from any expectation of intensified AGI-race capex. But this is a second-order, sentiment-driven linkage; the market question is about a self-declared, definitionally vague AGI 'announcement' that OpenAI has strong incentive not to make lightly, so information content is low and the proxy exposure is diffuse.

evidence_used: Market resolves Yes only on an official OpenAI (self-)declaration of AGI by end-2026
OpenAI is privately held; MSFT is its largest strategic investor and commercialization partner
AGI/compute narrative is a primary driver of NVDA and the broader AI equity complex
Prediction window is 12h with a 700bps tradability threshold
uncertainty_notes: OpenAI is not directly tradable, so all mappings are indirect proxies with diluted exposure
'AGI announcement' is definitionally vague and self-declared, making the resolution event low-probability and hard to leak meaningfully
A probability move on this market could be pure speculative noise rather than leaked information
Neither MSFT nor NVDA is likely to move 700bps in 12h absent a confirmed, concrete announcement — so neither is genuinely tradable under the stated threshold

llm_justification.summary: This market tracks a self-declared, definitionally ambiguous AGI announcement by a private company (OpenAI). The only liquid public proxies are Microsoft (largest backer) and the AI/semiconductor complex (NVDA). A sharp rise in implied probability would nominally be bullish for both, but the linkage is weak: proxies are diversified megacaps, the resolution event is vague and self-controlled by OpenAI, and moves are unlikely to reach the 700bps tradability threshold in 12h. Best treated as a low-confidence, non-tradable research signal.
key_assumptions: A move in this market reflects capability/announcement news rather than pure speculation
MSFT and NVDA are the most representative liquid proxies for an OpenAI breakthrough
No confirmed official AGI announcement occurs within the window (base case)
failure_modes: The probability spike is noise/thin-market manipulation with no real information, so proxies don't move
News is already public and priced in, giving no forward edge
Proxies are too diversified — even a real OpenAI story produces a sub-threshold move well under 700bps
Direction could invert: an 'AGI' claim could trigger regulatory/safety fear selloffs rather than rallies
OpenAI has strong incentive not to make a formal AGI declaration (contractual/Microsoft governance implications), so the resolution event may simply never fire
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
